# INVESTMENT MEMORANDUM

## 1. Executive Summary

**Date of Agreement:** 2021-11-30

**Borrower / Company Overview:** America First Multifamily Investors, L.P., a limited partnership operating through its general partner structure with America First Capital Associates Limited Partnership Two and managed by Greystone AF Manager LLC.

**Transaction Description:** This is a first amendment to an existing credit agreement originally dated June 11, 2021. The transaction involves BankUnited, N.A. as Administrative Agent and Lender, along with Bankers Trust Company as an additional Lender. The amendment modifies the guarantor structure and certain administrative provisions of the original credit facility.

**Purpose of Financing:** The document represents an amendment to modify existing credit terms rather than new financing. The specific purpose of the underlying credit facility is not disclosed in this amendment.

**Company Background:** America First Multifamily Investors, L.P. appears to be a real estate investment entity focused on multifamily properties, operating through a partnership structure with Greystone Select Incorporated serving as the guarantor under the amended and restated guaranty.

## 2. Investment Highlights & Risks

**Key Strengths / Credit Positives:**
• Established borrower with existing banking relationships including BankUnited, N.A. and Bankers Trust Company
• Strong guarantor support through Greystone Select Incorporated under amended and restated guaranty
• Borrower reaffirmed all representations and warranties, indicating continued compliance with credit terms
• Administrative Agent maintains first priority perfected liens on all collateral
• No events of default or material adverse effects reported as of amendment date
• Environmental indemnity protection provided by guarantor, borrower, and mortgagor

**Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:**
• Limited financial information available in amendment document to assess current credit profile
• Multifamily real estate exposure subject to market cycles and economic conditions
• Complex partnership structure with multiple entity layers may complicate enforcement
• Amendment suggests need for guarantor restructuring, though mitigated by continued guarantee from Greystone Select Incorporated
• General release provision limits lender liability claims but standard for amendment transactions
